checks.name: Attempt binds the existing receipt, sequence, projection and outbox in the real transaction
Foreign call, tool, private body and already-settled receipt attempts roll back
A native failure cannot erase an unknown external effect in recovery
A new cold journal restores the persisted unknown effect and never invents success
Never-delivered blocked operation cannot claim unknown effect or become admitted
Real SQLite attempt-event write refusal rolls back uncertain flag with event/projection/outbox
Cancelled admitted write without a final attempt event remains uncertain, while matched independent effect can resolve it
A cancelled pure read without a final attempt stays failed, with no invented external effect or replay
Queued read persists before admission and cold recovery marks it not delivered without replay
Ordinary missing-file category persists on the existing receipt and restores unchanged after cold recovery

scope: Actual SQLite attempt transactions and cold journal recovery; native/effect callbacks controlled, not provider/UI
